anomaly_alerts.title: How these numbers are counted
anomaly_alerts.description: Read as logistics data (on-time delivery, average transit time, cost per shipment, cost per lb, shipments). Rates pool their parts (on-time, OTIF, fill and cost per lb are totals divided, never averages of per-shipment rates). On time means on or before the promised date, dates as written (local); an early delivery is on time. Transit is in calendar days from the ship date. Cost is in the main currency only. 62 cancelled rows are left out of every count and rate. The data covers 10 months, so month-over-month changes may be seasonal (a peak season); there is no same month last year to compare with. 102 rows in currencies other than USD are left out of every figure, counts and on-time rates too, so the figures side by side read the same shipments. A carrier's figures depend on its lanes, modes and shippers: a difference between carriers is an association, not the carrier's doing, and every rate is given with its number of shipments.

paragraphs.text: The dataset captures freight logistics activity from January through October 2026, with costs and fuel surcharges varying meaningfully across carriers and shipping modes.

findings.text: Total charges range from $6.94 to $1,338.03 per shipment, with a median of $205.70 and a mean of $247.72, indicating a right-skewed distribution with some high-cost outliers.

FedEx Freight accounts for the highest total charges among carriers, while XPO accounts for the lowest; the difference reflects each carrier's mix of lanes, modes and volumes rather than carrier performance alone.
LTL shipments carry the highest total fuel surcharge of the three modes, while FTL carries the lowest.
Fuel surcharge fell 1.9% month-over-month in October 2026 versus September 2026; because the data spans only 10 months with no prior-year comparison, this change may reflect seasonal patterns.
Total Total Charge: FedEx Freight (200,941.87) is higher than XPO (62,300.94).
Total Fuel Surcharge: LTL (65,501.25) is higher than FTL (23,539.43).

Read as logistics data (OTIF (orders), OTIF (lines), unit fill rate, line fill rate, orders). Rates pool their parts (on-time, OTIF, fill and cost per lb are totals divided, never averages of per-shipment rates). On time means on or before the promised date, dates as written (local); an early delivery is on time. Transit is in calendar days from the ship date. Cost is in the main currency only.
110 cancelled rows are left out of every count and rate.
The data covers 8 months, so month-over-month changes may be seasonal (a peak season); there is no same month last year to compare with.
A carrier's figures depend on its lanes, modes and shippers: a difference between carriers is an association, not the carrier's doing, and every rate is given with its number of shipments.
